你是一位饱经沧桑的老巫师。你舒舒服服地坐在最华丽的王座上，目光专注于面前那件完美物体的曲线。这是你最爱的消遣，也是你真正的使命——沉思。你目光呆滞地凝视着宝珠，思索着其中所见：
stories.storyStart.storytellerPreview.2: scenes of various natural settings from around the world, but also scenes of war and destruction. There are otherworldly scenes such as glowing orbs and strange beings and even representations of things that don't quite seem possible. The orb seems to change the more time you spend staring into it. As you ponder the many wondrous sights, you grow older and wearier each day. But there are always new wonders to be seen and marveled over. As you look deeper into the orb, you see new places in the distance and begin to wonder if perhaps this is truly another universe hidden beyond the stars. The orb itself seems to grow brighter as you ponder, and then dims slightly when you turn away to take a break. Each time you gaze at it, you feel the need to return to your throne and continue contemplating. Eventually the orb begins to glow bright again, and you must return to contemplate once more.

世界各地的自然风光，也有战争与毁灭的场面。还有些异界景象，比如发光的球体和奇怪的生物，甚至还有一些看起来不太可能存在的事物。你盯着宝珠看得越久，它似乎就变化得越多。在思索这许多奇景的过程中，你一天比一天苍老、疲惫。但总有新的奇迹等着你去观赏、去惊叹。你往宝珠深处望去，看到远方出现了新的地方，开始怀疑这是否真是一个隐藏在群星之外的另一个宇宙。你沉思时，宝珠本身似乎变得更亮了；当你转过身去休息时，它又稍稍暗了下来。每当你凝视它，你都感到有必要回到王座上继续沉思。最终，宝珠又开始明亮起来，你必须再次回去沉思。

启用此设置的条目通常应设置比故事上下文（默认 0）更低的插入顺序，并预留足够的 token。
大量相对插入的设定集条目会拖慢上下文的构建。
lorebook.cascadingActivationTooltip:
When enabled the Lorebook entry will search for keys in non-story context entries. 
Search range is not taken into account for non-story context entries. Text from the entry that caused the activation is not guaranteed to end up within the context.

启用后，设定集条目也会在非故事的上下文条目中搜索关键词。
对非故事的上下文条目不考虑搜索范围。触发激活的条目中的文本不一定会出现在上下文中。
lorebook.alwaysOnTooltip: Causes the Lorebook entry to always activate regardless of whether a key was detected.
无论是否检测到关键词，设定集条目都会始终激活。
lorebook.deleteCategory.text.0: Are you sure you want to delete the category "[0]"?
lorebook.deleteCategory.title: Delete Category?
删除分类？
lorebook.deleteContainingEntriesChecked: Deleting the category will also delete all entries within it.
删除分类时，会一并删除其中的所有条目。
lorebook.deleteContainingEntriesUnchecke: Deleting the category will move all entries out of the category.
删除分类时，会把其中的所有条目移出分类。
lorebook.hiddenEntryDesc.0: 这个设定集条目已隐藏。
lorebook.hiddenEntryDesc.1: You can reveal it by clicking the button below.
点击下方按钮可以显示它。
lorebook.activationKeysTooltip:
A Lorebook entry is activated and its text placed in context whenever one of its keys is found in the recent story. Keys are case-insensitive. 
Keys that begin and end with "/" are evaluated as regex. These regex keys are case-sensitive and support the following flags: i, s, m, and u.

只要在最近的故事中找到条目的任一关键词，设定集条目就会被激活，其文本会被放入上下文。关键词不区分大小写。
以「/」开头和结尾的关键词会作为正则表达式处理。正则关键词区分大小写，支持 i、s、m、u 标志。
lorebook.activationKeysSub: Activates the entry when found within the recent story.
在最近的故事中找到时激活该条目。
lorebook.activationKeyPlaceholder: Type a key here and hit enter to save it
在此输入关键词，按回车保存
lorebook.selectAKeyToEditIt: Select a key to edit it
选择一个关键词进行编辑
lorebook.contextOverloaded: 上下文超载：有 [0] 个字符被排除。
lorebook.entryTextSub: The following text will be referenced when the Keys are activated.
关键词被激活时，会引用以下文本。
lorebook.generatorTooltip: Let the AI fill in the blanks for you! Choose the type of entry from the list, enter what you want to generate, and hit generate. You can also have the AI add to text written in the Lore entry just like in the Story.
让 AI 帮你填空！从列表中选择条目类型，输入想生成的内容，然后点击生成。你也可以像在故事中一样，让 AI 续写设定条目中已有的文本。
lorebook.generationTypeTooltip: Influences the generator towards generating a specific type of entry. A custom type can be set by typing with the dropdown open and hitting enter.
引导生成器生成特定类型的条目。打开下拉菜单后直接输入并按回车，可以设置自定义类型。
lorebook.inputTextTooltip:
This is where you put what you want to be generated. Proper nouns like "Geometry Incorporated" or short descriptions like "an enthusiastic merchant" work best.

You can add tags in parenthesis to further describe the entry, e.g. "Stalagmal (prison, space)"

在这里写下想生成的内容。像「Geometry Incorporated」这样的专有名词，或「一个热情的商人」这样的简短描述效果最好。

可以在括号中加标签来进一步描述条目，例如「Stalagmal（监狱，太空）」
lorebook.addContextTooltip: Include Memory, Author's Note, the most recent story text (~2500 characters), or other Lorebook entries in context so that information can be used in generating entries.
将记忆、作者注释、最近的故事文本（约 2500 个字符）或其他设定集条目放入上下文，以便生成条目时使用这些信息。
lorebook.enterLorebookKeysToSearch: 输入要搜索的设定集关键词
lorebook.lorebookKeySearchTooltip: The text here will be searched for Lorebook activation keys, and the matching Lore placed in context.
会在这里的文本中搜索设定集的激活关键词，并将匹配的设定放入上下文。
lorebook.generationHistoryDesc: Shows the last 50 outputs. Cleared on page refresh.
显示最近 50 条输出，刷新页面后清空。
lorebook.entryTextPlaceholder: Type information about the entry here.
在此输入关于该条目的信息。
lorebook.advancedConditionsTooltip: Advanced conditions allow more complex logic for when this lore entry should activate.
高级条件可以用更复杂的逻辑决定这个设定条目何时激活。
lorebook.noAdvancedConditions: No advanced conditions configured. Click "Add Condition" to create one.
未配置高级条件。点击「添加条件」创建一个。
lorebook.advancedConditionsNote.1: Multiple top-level conditions use OR logic. The entry will activate if any condition evaluates to true.
多个顶层条件之间是「或」的关系，任一条件为真时条目就会激活。
lorebook.advancedConditionsInfo.searchRa: Number of characters from the end of the story to search
从故事末尾往前搜索的字符数
lorebook.advancedConditionsInfo.lore: Activate when this Lorebook entry is active:
当这个设定集条目激活时激活：
lorebook.advancedConditionsInfo.equation: Terms and operators are evaluated in the order they appear. No operator precedence is applied.
各项和运算符按出现的顺序依次计算，不考虑运算符优先级。
lorebook.advancedConditionsInfo.model: Activate when using this AI Model:
使用此 AI 模型时激活：
lorebook.advancedConditionsInfo.storyMod: Activate when the story is in this mode:
故事处于此模式时激活：
lorebook.lorebookEntryHeaderDescription: The text entered here will be automatically placed above any entry in this category.
这里输入的文本会自动放在此分类中每个条目的上方。
lorebook.lorebookEntryHeaderTooltip: This text is being added by the "Lorebook Category Header" setting in the category this entry belongs to.
这段文本来自该条目所属分类的「设定集分类标头」设置。
contextSettings.prefixTooltip: Text prepended to the entry after trimming and before inserting it into context.
条目经裁剪后、插入上下文前，加在开头的文本。
contextSettings.suffixTooltip: Text appended to the entry after trimming and before inserting it into context.
条目经裁剪后、插入上下文前，加在末尾的文本。
contextSettings.tokenBudgetTooltip:
The maximum amount of tokens of the context the entry may use. 
Decimal numbers between 0 and 1 (inclusive) will be interpreted as a percentage of the maximum context size (max tokens - output length).

条目在上下文中最多可使用的 token 数。
0 到 1 之间（含）的小数会被视为最大上下文长度（最大 token 数 - 输出长度）的百分比。
contextSettings.reservedTokensTooltip:
The number of tokens of the context the entry may reserve for itself. All reservations are made before any entries are placed in context. It will not reserve more tokens than the entry actually contains. 
Decimal numbers between 0 and 1 (inclusive) will be interpreted as a percentage of the maximum context size (max tokens - output length).

条目可以在上下文中为自己预留的 token 数。所有预留都在放入任何条目之前完成。预留的 token 数不会超过条目实际包含的数量。
0 到 1 之间（含）的小数会被视为最大上下文长度（最大 token 数 - 输出长度）的百分比。
contextSettings.insertionOrderTooltip:
Entries are ordered by their insertion order before context is built. Entries with higher insertion order will reserve tokens and be inserted into the context first. 
If two entries share the same insertion order there is no guarantee which will be inserted first.

构建上下文前，条目会按插入顺序排序。插入顺序越高的条目越先预留 token、越先插入上下文。
如果两个条目的插入顺序相同，无法保证哪个先插入。
contextSettings.insertionPositionTooltip:
The location the entry will be inserted into the context. 0 is the very top of the context, 1 is one unit down, 2 is two units down etc. 
Negative numbers will count from the bottom of the context starting with -1 at the very bottom, making -2 one unit up, -3 two units up etc.

条目在上下文中的插入位置。0 是上下文的最顶端，1 是往下一个单位，2 是往下两个单位，依此类推。
负数从上下文底部开始计数，-1 是最底端，-2 是往上一个单位，-3 是往上两个单位，依此类推。
contextSettings.trimDirectionTooltip:
The direction the entry will be trimmed from when the entire entry will not fit in the context. 
If set to 'Do Not Trim' the entry will only be included if the entirety of its text will fit within the context.

整个条目放不进上下文时，从哪个方向裁剪条目。
设为「不裁剪」时，只有全部文本都能放进上下文，才会包含该条目。
contextSettings.maximumTrimTypeTooltip: The extent to which the entry is allowed to be trimmed in the order newline > sentence > token.
条目允许被裁剪的程度，按 换行 > 句子 > token 的顺序。
contextSettings.insertionTypeTooltip: Determines what units will be used to separate the context when inserting entries.
决定插入条目时用什么单位分隔上下文。
phraseBias.phraseBiasDesc: Weigh the AI’s chance of generating certain words or phrases.
调整 AI 生成特定单词或短语的概率。
phraseBias.phraseBiasOpenAICompletionDes: Weigh the AI’s chance of generating specific tokens.
调整 AI 生成特定 token 的概率。
phraseBias.biasTooltip: Set a bias on words or phrases to increase or decrease their chance of being generated. Surround with {curly braces} to input exact text. Surround with [square brackets] to input token ids (tokenizer specific)
为单词或短语设置偏置，以提高或降低它们被生成的概率。用 {花括号} 包围可输入精确文本，用 [方括号] 包围可输入 token ID（取决于分词器）
phraseBias.biasOpenAICompletionTooltip: Set a bias on specific tokens to increase or decrease their chance of being generated. Surround with [square brackets] to input token ids (tokenizer specific). If a sequence of tokens is given, only the first will have the bias applied.
为特定 token 设置偏置，以提高或降低它们被生成的概率。用 [方括号] 包围可输入 token ID（取决于分词器）。如果给出一串 token，只有第一个会应用偏置。
phraseBias.instruction: Type in the area below, then press enter to save.
在下方输入，然后按回车保存。
phraseBias.placeholder: Enter the text you want to bias
输入要设置偏置的文本
phraseBias.zeroWarning: A bias of zero will have no effect.
phraseBias.highBiasWarning: A bias greater than [0] will have a very strong effect. Recommended values are between -[0] and [0].
偏置大于 [0] 时效果会非常强烈。推荐值在 -[0] 到 [0] 之间。
phraseBias.lowBiasdWarning: A bias less than -[0] will have a very strong effect. Recommended values are between -[0] and [0].
偏置小于 -[0] 时效果会非常强烈。推荐值在 -[0] 到 [0] 之间。
phraseBias.clickToEdit: Click a phrase to edit it.
phraseBias.clickToEditOpenAICompletion: Click a token to edit it.
点击 token 进行编辑。
phraseBias.enableTooltip: Enable or disable this phrase group.
phraseBias.whenEntryInactiveTooltip: When enabled, this group will be applied when the entry is inactive instead of when active.
启用后，此组会在条目未激活时应用，而不是激活时。
phraseBias.whenAllEntriesInactiveTooltip: When enabled. this group will only be applied when none of the entries in this category are active.
启用后，此组只在本分类中没有任何条目激活时应用。
phraseBias.ensureCompletion: 开头生成后确保完整生成
phraseBias.ensureCompletionTooltip: When enabled, if the first token of a phrase is generated,                                     subsequent tokens will always generate.
启用后，一旦生成了短语的第一个 token，后续 token 也一定会生成。
phraseBias.unbiasWhenGeneratedTooltip:
When enabled, after a phrase is generated its bias will be removed for the rest of the generation. 
This will not prevent it from being generated, only remove the bias placed on it.

启用后，短语生成之后，本次生成的剩余部分将不再对其应用偏置。
这不会阻止它再次生成，只是去掉施加在它上面的偏置。
phraseBias.avoidOverusedWordsChecked: Reduces the chance of generating words and phrases overused by AI models.
降低生成被 AI 模型过度使用的词语和短语的概率。
phraseBias.avoidOverusedWordsUnchecked: Words will be chosen solely based on their natural likelihood of being generated.
只按词语自然的生成概率来选词。
bannedTokens.bannedTokensDesc: Prevents certain token sequences from being generated.
阻止生成特定的 token 序列。
bannedTokens.bannedTokensTooltip: Ban sequences of tokens from being generated. Input regularly to automatically ban variants. Surround with {curly braces} to input exact text. Surround with [square brackets] to input token ids (tokenizer specific)
禁止生成某些 token 序列。正常输入会自动禁用其变体。用 {花括号} 包围可输入精确文本，用 [方括号] 包围可输入 token ID（取决于分词器）
bannedTokens.banBracketGenerationChecked: Tokens containing brackets won't be generated
不会生成包含括号的 token
bannedTokens.banBracketGenerationUncheck: Tokens containing brackets can be generated
可以生成包含括号的 token
bannedTokens.inputPlaceholder: Enter the text you want to ban
bannedTokens.clickToEdit: Click a sequence to edit it.
bannedTokens.enableTooltip: Enable or disable this ban group.

故事
infobar.story.saveStoryModuleToAccount: 将故事模组保存到账户
infobar.story.taModuleRecommended: Using the [0] module is recommended with the Text Adventure ui.
使用文字冒险界面时，推荐使用 [0] 模组。
infobar.story.aiModulesSub: Changes the style of the AI generated text.
改变 AI 生成文本的风格。
infobar.story.instructHelp: How does Instruct work? Click here to find out!
指令模组怎么用？点这里了解！
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.1: This is an experimental instruct module we're testing so just about everything about it is subject to change. Additional tools and features will be added in the future.
这是我们正在测试的实验性指令模组，几乎所有方面都可能变化。将来还会加入更多工具和功能。
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.2: Instructions in their raw form are formatted like this:
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.3: { Write a description of the sights and sounds of public transit. }
{ Write a description of the sights and sounds of public transit. }
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.4: In editor V2 stories however, to make things a bit easier, you just need to type "{" at the start of a line; this will mark the paragraph as an instruction. No need to close it, all the brackets will be handled for you!
不过在 V2 编辑器的故事中，为了方便起见，只需在行首输入「{」，这一段就会被标记为指令。无需闭合，所有括号都会自动处理！
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.5: 不选指令模组也能用指令？
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.6: You can still do instructions without the Instruct module selected!
即使没有选中指令模组，也照样可以使用指令！
infobar.story.instructHelpContent.7: When you use a command, generation will swap to the Instruct module momentarily (for about 1000 characters), letting you use the occasional instruction without having to switch modules.
使用指令时，生成会临时切换到指令模组（约 1000 个字符），这样偶尔用一下指令时就不必切换模组了。
infobar.story.configPresetSub: Changes the settings of the AI model.
改变 AI 模型的设置。
infobar.story.memorySub: The AI will better remember info placed here.
AI 会更好地记住放在这里的信息。
infobar.story.authorsNoteSub: Info placed here will strongly influence AI output.
放在这里的信息会强烈影响 AI 的输出。

高级
infobar.advanced.duplicateAndStartSub: Imports current story as a scenario with placeholders
将当前故事作为带占位符的剧本导入
infobar.advanced.minOutputLengthTooltip:
The minimum generated output length in tokens, which are 4-5 characters long on average.
Only has an effect if at least one Stop Sequence is set.

生成输出的最小长度，单位为 token，平均每个 token 4-5 个字符。
只有设置了至少一个停止序列时才生效。
infobar.advanced.stopSequencesTooltip: Cuts generation short upon reaching a specified token sequence. Note: if under minimum output length ([0]), generation will not be interrupted. Surround with [square brackets] to input token ids (tokenizer specific)
生成到指定的 token 序列时提前结束。注意：未达到最小输出长度（[0]）时不会中断生成。用 [方括号] 包围可输入 token ID（取决于分词器）
infobar.advanced.stopSequencesOpenAIComp: Cuts generation short upon reaching a specified string.
生成到指定的字符串时提前结束。

在此输入，按回车添加停止序列

生成设置
infobar.generationSettings.cantDeleteNon: 无法删除非用户创建的预设 [0]
infobar.generationSettings.presetAreadyI: Preset "[0]" for AI Model "[1]" was already imported" as "[2]"
AI 模型「[1]」的预设「[0]」已经以「[2]」的名称导入过了
infobar.generationSettings.importedPrese: 已导入 AI 模型「[1]」的预设「[0]」
infobar.generationSettings.importedGener: 已将生成设置导入为预设
infobar.generationSettings.cfgWarning.0: This preset uses CFG, which is no longer supported.
此预设使用了已不再支持的 CFG。
infobar.generationSettings.cfgWarning.1: Performance may be affected. Another preset is recommended.
可能会影响效果，建议换用其他预设。
infobar.generationSettings.configPresetS: Choose from a selection of generation settings.
从一系列生成设置中选择。
infobar.generationSettings.presetInputPl: Type name here and press enter
在此输入名称，按回车确认
infobar.generationSettings.randomnessToo: The higher the value, the more random the output!
infobar.generationSettings.outputLengthT: Increase the length of the generated responses
infobar.generationSettings.repetitionPen: Higher values make the output less repetitive.
数值越高，输出越不容易重复。
infobar.generationSettings.topKTooltip: Keeps this many tokens, and deletes the rest.
保留这么多个 token，删除其余的。
infobar.generationSettings.nucleusToolti: Adds the largest token probabilities until the sum reaches this value, then deletes the leftover tokens. Higher settings preserve more tokens.
从概率最高的 token 开始累加，直到总和达到此值，然后删除剩余的 token。数值越高，保留的 token 越多。
infobar.generationSettings.tailFreeToolt: Trims low-probability tokens using a complex calculation. Higher settings preserve more tokens.
用一种复杂的计算裁掉低概率的 token。数值越高，保留的 token 越多。
infobar.generationSettings.topATooltip: Deletes tokens with probability smaller than (top probability)^2 * A.
删除概率小于（最高概率）^2 * A 的 token。
infobar.generationSettings.typicalToolti: Deletes low-probability tokens and occasionally high-probability tokens, leaving the middle. Higher settings preserve more tokens.
删除低概率的 token，偶尔也删除高概率的 token，保留中间的部分。数值越高，保留的 token 越多。
infobar.generationSettings.phraseRepetit: Phrase Repetition Penalty penalizes token sequences, reducing the chance of generations repeating earlier text. Can be used alongside other repetition penalty settings, but isn't affected by them.
短语重复惩罚针对 token 序列施加惩罚，降低生成内容重复前文的概率。可以与其他重复惩罚设置同时使用，但不受它们影响。
infobar.generationSettings.selectAPhrase: Select a Phrase Repetition Penalty Strength
选择短语重复惩罚强度
infobar.generationSettings.useDefaultWhi: A default set of tokens will be ignored by repetition penalty.
重复惩罚会忽略一组默认的 token。
Repetition penalty will apply to all tokens.
重复惩罚会应用于所有 token。
infobar.generationSettings.rangeTooltip: How many tokens, starting from the last generated one, will be considered repeated if they appear in the next output.
从最后生成的 token 往前算，有多少个 token 在下一次输出中再次出现时会被视为重复。
infobar.generationSettings.dynamicRangeC: The repetition penalty range is dynamic, only applying to "Story" text.
重复惩罚范围是动态的，只作用于「故事」文本。
infobar.generationSettings.dynamicRangeU: The repetition penalty range is a fixed number of tokens.
重复惩罚范围是固定的 token 数。
infobar.generationSettings.slopeTooltip:
Affects the ramping of the penalty's harshness, starting from the final token. 
Higher values penalize the final tokens more harshly, but are softer on the earlier tokens. Lower values cause a smoother reduction of probability across all tokens.

影响惩罚强度从最后一个 token 开始的递变方式。
数值越高，对最后的 token 惩罚越重，对较早的 token 越轻；数值越低，所有 token 的概率降低得越平缓。
infobar.generationSettings.presenceToolt: Applies a static penalty to the generation of tokens that appear within the Repetition Penalty Range.
对出现在重复惩罚范围内的 token 施加固定的惩罚。
infobar.generationSettings.frequencyTool: Applies a penalty to the generation of tokens based on the number of occurrences of that token within the Repetition Penalty Range.
根据 token 在重复惩罚范围内出现的次数施加惩罚。
infobar.generationSettings.cfgScaleDescr: Enabling this setting will double the time it takes to generate a response.
启用此设置会使生成回应所需的时间翻倍。
infobar.generationSettings.opposingPromp: Reading the [0] before setting an opposing prompt is recommended.
设置反向提示前，建议先阅读[0]。
Opposing prompt: Add text here that would make the AI generate things you don't want in your outputs.
反向提示：在此添加会让 AI 生成你不想要的内容的文本。
infobar.generationSettings.topGTooltip: Functions similarly to Top-K, but acts on groups of tokens with equal probabilities.
作用类似 Top-K，但以概率相同的一组 token 为单位。
infobar.generationSettings.mirostatTauTo: Mirostat aims to keep the text at a fixed complexity set by tau. It may not play well with other restrictive sampling settings.
Mirostat 试图将文本保持在由 tau 设定的固定复杂度。可能与其他限制性的采样设置配合不佳。
infobar.generationSettings.mirostatLRToo: Mirostat aims to keep the text at a fixed complexity set by tau. It may not play well with other restrictive sampling settings.
Mirostat 试图将文本保持在由 tau 设定的固定复杂度。可能与其他限制性的采样设置配合不佳。
infobar.generationSettings.linearTooltip: High values make the output less random.
数值越高，输出越不随机。
infobar.generationSettings.quadTooltip: High values make the low probabilities much lower.
数值越高，低概率会被压得越低。
infobar.generationSettings.confTooltip: High values make random outputs less random.
数值越高，随机的输出越不随机。
infobar.generationSettings.minPTooltip: Deletes tokens with probability smaller than (top probability) * P.
删除概率小于（最高概率）* P 的 token。
infobar.generationSettings.experimentati: Experimentation with these settings is encouraged, but be warned that their effects aren't always obvious.
鼓励多尝试这些设置，但要注意它们的效果并不总是那么明显。
这份指南解释了这些设置。
infobar.generationSettings.alternateRepe: These options will strongly impact generation and are not recommended to set to high values.
这些选项会强烈影响生成，不建议设得太高。
可以在这里调整采样器的顺序。
Disabled samplers will be hidden from the sidebar.
停用的采样器会从侧边栏隐藏。
infobar.generationSettings.unifiedLeftWa: Unified sliders are too far to the left, which can cause mistakes.
Unified 滑块太靠左，可能导致出错。
infobar.generationSettings.unifiedRightW: Unified sliders are too far to the right, which can cause repetition.
Unified 滑块太靠右，可能导致重复。
infobar.generationSettings.unifiedConfNe: Conf 只有在大于 -Quad 时才有意义。
contextViewer.contextDesc: Get a full view of what’s sent to the AI.
完整查看发送给 AI 的内容。
contextViewer.systemPromptDesc: The system prompt is the initial system message given to the model. Leave blank for the default system message.
系统提示词是提供给模型的初始系统消息。留空则使用默认的系统消息。
contextViewer.prefillAdjustmentWarning: Using a prefill for this model is not recommended and will likely cause issues.
不建议对此模型使用预填充，很可能会导致问题。
contextViewer.prefillDesc: The prefill is inserted at the beginning of the most recent assistant message. Leave blank to use the default prefill.
预填充会插在最近一条助手消息的开头。留空则使用默认的预填充。
contextViewer.authorsNoteContextSettings: 作者注释的上下文设置
contextViewer.defaultLorebookSettingsToo: Newly created Lorebook entries will use these settings.
新建的设定集条目将使用这些设置。
contextViewer.structuredOuputDidNotMatch: Structured output did not match text output.
结构化输出与文本输出不一致。
contextViewer.xTokensFilledOutOfAMaximum: [0] tokens filled out of a maximum of [1]
已填充 [0] 个 token，上限 [1]
contextViewer.belowTheLastFoundKey: 在最后找到的关键词之下
contextViewer.aboveTheLastFoundKey: 在最后找到的关键词之上
contextViewer.shuntedXCharacters: (shunted [0] characters to prevent insertion inside another entry)
（为避免插到其他条目内部，移动了 [0] 个字符）
contextViewer.errorCreatingStructuredOut: Error creating structured output [0] at location [1]. Allowed range 0-[2]
在位置 [1] 创建结构化输出 [0] 时出错。允许范围为 0-[2]
contextViewer.removedLoreActivatingComme: 已移除会激活设定的注释。
contextViewer.addedNewlineToEndOfContext: Added newline to end of context.
已在上下文末尾添加换行。
contextViewer.removedEndOfText: Removed <|endoftext|> from context. Do not use this token on this model.
已从上下文中移除 <|endoftext|>。请勿在此模型上使用这个 token。
contextViewer.identifierTooltip: The identifier for the context entry. Lorebook entries will use their display name.
上下文条目的标识。设定集条目使用其显示名称。
contextViewer.inclusionTooltip: Whether or not the entry was included in the context or not. A partially included entry is one that was trimmed.
条目是否被包含在上下文中。部分包含表示条目被裁剪过。
contextViewer.reasonTooltip: The reason the entry was included or excluded from the context.
条目被包含或排除在上下文之外的原因。
contextViewer.keyTooltip: If the entry was included because it was a Lorebook entry activated by a key the key will be shown here.
如果条目是因关键词激活的设定集条目而被包含，这里会显示该关键词。
contextViewer.reservedTooltip: The number of tokens that were reserved by the entry.
条目预留的 token 数。
contextViewer.tokensTooltip:
The number of tokens that were used by the entry.
The total of this column may not be the same as the length of the resulting context.

条目使用的 token 数。
这一列的总和不一定等于最终上下文的长度。
contextViewer.trimTypeTooltip:
How the entry was trimmed to be able to fit it into the context.
The priority used when trimming is no trim > newline > sentence > token.

为了放进上下文，条目是如何被裁剪的。
裁剪的优先级为 不裁剪 > 换行 > 句子 > token。
contextViewer.numberOfIncludedPhraseBias: Number of Included Phrase Bias Groups
包含的短语偏置组数量
contextViewer.transformedToMessages: 已将上下文转换为消息格式。
contextViewer.advancedConditionsFailedTo: Advanced conditions failed to settle after 30 iterations. You have probably created an infinite loop.
高级条件迭代 30 次后仍未稳定，你可能制造了一个无限循环。
ephemeralContext.desc.0: Ephemeral context entries let you insert context based on the current 'step' of the story. They can be entered in the format {step+delay~duration,position:text} with all but 'text' being numbers. Only the position and text are required.
临时上下文条目可以根据故事当前的「步骤」插入上下文。格式为 {step+delay~duration,position:text}，除 text 外都是数字。只有 position 和 text 是必填的。
ephemeralContext.desc.1:
Example: 
The ephemeral context entry {+3~10,-2:Example} would place the text 'Example' 1 newline from the bottom of the context for 10 steps after a delay of 3 steps.

示例：
临时上下文条目 {+3~10,-2:Example} 会在延迟 3 步后，把文本「Example」放在距上下文底部 1 个换行的位置，持续 10 步。
moduleBrowser.importedSub: Modules imported from a file or scenario.
从文件或剧本导入的模组。
moduleBrowser.specialsSub: 带有额外功能的特殊模组
moduleBrowser.generalSub: 适合多种情况的通用模组。
moduleBrowser.themeSub: Drive your writing in a specific thematic direction.
让你的写作朝特定的主题方向发展。
moduleBrowser.inspirationSub: 从知名作品中汲取灵感。
moduleBrowser.noModulesFound: No modules meet the current search conditions.
没有符合当前搜索条件的模组。
modules.vanilla.label: No Module
无模组
modules.special_openings.label: Special: Openings
特殊：开篇
modules.special_instruct.label: General: Instruct (Experimental)
通用：指令（实验性）
modules.special_instruct.description: Use Instruct commands to give the AI a specific direction.
用指令命令给 AI 指定具体方向。
modules.general_crossgenre.label: General: Cross-Genre
通用：跨体裁
modules.general_crossgenre.description: A general module for many genres.
适用于多种体裁的通用模组。
modules.theme_textadventure.label: Special: Text Adventure
特殊：文字冒险
modules.theme_textadventure.description: It's up to you whether to change your course of action. Do you proceed?
要不要改变行动方向，由你决定。继续前进吗？
modules.special_proseaugmenter.label: General: Prose Augmenter
通用：文笔增强
modules.special_proseaugmenter.descripti: A general module for verbose prose. If you find the AI struggling with short sentences                 and other writing quality pitfalls, Prose Augmenter can help.
用于繁复文笔的通用模组。如果 AI 总是写短句或有其他文笔问题，文笔增强可以帮上忙。
modules.style_algernonblackwood.label: Style: Algernon Blackwood
风格：阿尔杰农·布莱克伍德
modules.style_algernonblackwood.descript: The unquestioned master of weird atmosphere, unusual fiction and ghost stories.
诡异氛围、奇特小说和鬼故事无可争议的大师。
modules.style_arthurconandoyle.label: Style: Arthur Conan Doyle
风格：阿瑟·柯南·道尔
modules.style_arthurconandoyle.descripti: A master detective seeks the truth in every case, solving crimes with logic, wit, and a keen mind. It's elementary, my dear.
一位神探在每桩案件中追寻真相，用逻辑、机智和敏锐的头脑破案。这很简单，我亲爱的朋友。
modules.style_edgarallanpoe.label: Style: Edgar Allan Poe
风格：埃德加·爱伦·坡
modules.style_edgarallanpoe.description: The darkness in man's soul, the twisted will of a madman. Influenced by the works of one of literature's greatest authors.
人类灵魂中的黑暗，疯子扭曲的意志。受文学史上最伟大的作家之一的作品影响。
modules.style_hplovecraft.label: Style: H.P. Lovecraft
风格：H.P. 洛夫克拉夫特
modules.style_hplovecraft.description: In a forgotten corner of the universe, beings stretch out ethereal tendrils. Who knows what unknown horrors lurk in the shadows...?
在宇宙被遗忘的角落，某些存在伸出缥缈的触须。谁知道阴影中潜藏着怎样未知的恐怖……？
modules.style_shridanlefanu.label: Style: Sheridan Le Fanu
风格：谢里丹·勒法努
modules.style_shridanlefanu.description: It's a restless and scrupulous passion, curiosity. What whispers slip between the veil of light and shadow?
好奇心是一种躁动而执拗的激情。光与影的帷幕之间，流淌着怎样的低语？
modules.style_janeausten.label: Style: Jane Austen
风格：简·奥斯汀
modules.style_janeausten.description: Experience a Regency world of wit, romance, and social politics.
体验摄政时期充满机智、浪漫与社交政治的世界。
modules.style_julesverne.label: Style: Jules Verne
风格：儒勒·凡尔纳
modules.style_julesverne.description: Journey to distant lands to explore strange cultures. Travel to a world of tribal folk, mermaids, and dinosaurs.
远赴他乡，探索奇异的文化。前往一个有部落居民、美人鱼和恐龙的世界。
modules.style_williamshakespeare.label: Style: William Shakespeare
风格：威廉·莎士比亚
modules.style_williamshakespeare.descrip: Beguiling language - in script form, tragedy, all-powerful characters, and a world of romantic fantasy and adventure.
迷人的语言——剧本形式、悲剧、无所不能的角色，以及充满浪漫幻想与冒险的世界。
modules.theme_19thcenturyromance.label: Theme: 19th Century Romance
主题：19 世纪浪漫
modules.theme_19thcenturyromance.descrip: Take a trip down memory lane to an era when chivalry was king. Witness love affairs bloom, and scandalous trysts be exposed!
重回骑士精神至上的时代。见证恋情绽放，丑闻幽会曝光！
modules.theme_actionarcheology.label: Theme: Action Archeology
主题：动作考古
modules.theme_actionarcheology.descripti: Rumors of great treasures abound throughout history. Follow clues through mystical ruins, avoiding devious traps along the way.
历史上流传着无数宝藏的传说。追寻线索穿越神秘的遗迹，一路避开狡诈的机关。
modules.theme_ai.label: Theme: Artificial Intelligence
主题：人工智能
modules.theme_ai.description: In this world of silicon, the line between machine and human blurs. Dream of electric sheep, or starships off a distant world.
在这个硅的世界里，机器与人的界线逐渐模糊。梦见电子羊，或是来自遥远世界的星舰。
modules.theme_ancientchina.label: Theme: Ancient China
主题：古代中国
modules.theme_ancientchina.description: Ancient China's turbulent history comes alive, featuring the rise of an Empire, celestial bureaucracy, and heroes. Claim your own destiny, or serve others' whims!
古代中国动荡的历史在此重现：帝国的崛起、天庭的官僚体系与英雄豪杰。是掌握自己的命运，还是听凭他人摆布？
modules.theme_ancientgreek.label: Theme: Ancient Greece
主题：古希腊
modules.theme_ancientgreek.description: Wander through the streets of Athens, drink wine in tavernas, listen to the songs of the rhapsodists while you befriend the gods—or betray them.
漫步雅典街头，在酒馆里饮酒，聆听吟游诗人的歌声，与众神结交——或背叛他们。
modules.theme_india.label: Theme: Ancient India
主题：古印度
modules.theme_india.description: Find your place in ancient Indian society: Ancient Indian mythology, magic, demons, yadavs, rakshas, and more! A vast universe of myth and legend awaits!
在古印度社会中找到你的位置：古印度神话、魔法、恶魔、雅达瓦族、罗刹等等！一个广阔的神话与传说宇宙正等着你！
modules.theme_animalfiction.label: Theme: Animal Fiction
主题：动物小说
modules.theme_animalfiction.description: Drawing from fiction written from the perspective of animals or about animals, be a fierce lion, cunning crow, or tall giraffe. Be whatever animal you desire!
取材于以动物视角写成或关于动物的小说。做一头凶猛的狮子、一只狡猾的乌鸦，或是一头高大的长颈鹿。想当什么动物都行！
modules.theme_anthropomorphicanimals.des: Begone, hands! It's time for paws, tails, wings, and claws! These anthro animals have fur, and a lot of it.
手，退下！现在是爪子、尾巴、翅膀和利爪的时代！这些兽人浑身是毛，而且很多。
modules.theme_childrens.label: Theme: Children's Fiction
主题：儿童文学
modules.theme_childrens.description: Evoke your inner child and engage in an adventure that will take you back to earlier days.
唤醒你内心的孩子，踏上一场带你回到童年的冒险。
modules.theme_christmas.label: Theme: Christmas
主题：圣诞节
modules.theme_christmas.description: A joyful thematic wildcard to instantly transport you into the merriest season of the year!
一张欢乐的主题百搭牌，瞬间把你带进一年中最快乐的季节！
modules.theme_comedicfantasy.label: Theme: Comedic Fantasy
主题：喜剧奇幻
modules.theme_comedicfantasy.description: Fantasy of a satirical and humorous bent, with witty narrators, bumbling wizards, and heroic but yet inept warriors!
带有讽刺和幽默色彩的奇幻故事，有机智的叙述者、笨手笨脚的巫师，还有英勇却无能的战士！
modules.theme_contemporary.label: Theme: Contemporary
主题：当代
modules.theme_contemporary.description: Relatively relatable: portraying modern everyday life.
相对贴近生活：描绘现代的日常生活。
modules.theme_cyberpunk.label: Theme: Cyberpunk
主题：赛博朋克
modules.theme_cyberpunk.description: Jack into the Grid, and conduct cybernetic warfare against other sentients. Enhance your body with various cybernetic enhancements and perform espionage in a dystopia.
接入网格，与其他智能体展开赛博战争。用各种义体改造强化身体，在反乌托邦中从事间谍活动。
modules.theme_darkfantasy.label: Theme: Dark Fantasy
主题：黑暗奇幻
modules.theme_darkfantasy.description: The gifted few harness strange powers. When fortresses are besieged, this ancient world will be pushed to the brink.
少数天赋异禀之人驾驭着奇异的力量。当要塞被围，这个古老的世界将被推向崩溃的边缘。
modules.theme_dragons.label: Theme: Dragons
主题：巨龙
modules.theme_dragons.description: Crimson skies are dominated by wings like hurricanes and teeth like daggers. This realm is ruled over by fire breathers of legend.
猩红的天空被飓风般的翅膀和匕首般的利齿主宰。这片国度由传说中的喷火者统治。
modules.theme_egypt.label: Theme: Egypt
主题：埃及
modules.theme_egypt.description: Mummies stir in the desert, seeking freedom from their curse. Explore ancient pyramids, and discover why the pharaohs were revered beyond their time.
木乃伊在沙漠中苏醒，寻求摆脱诅咒。探索古老的金字塔，发现法老们为何在后世依然受人崇敬。
modules.theme_feudaljapan.label: Theme: Feudal Japan
主题：封建日本
modules.theme_feudaljapan.description: Go back to Feudal Japan, where samurai epics abound, along with detective stories, and tales of love conveyed through poetry.
回到封建时代的日本，那里有大量武士史诗、侦探故事，以及以诗传情的爱情故事。
modules.theme_gaming.label: Theme: Gaming
主题：游戏
modules.theme_gaming.description: Experience the crunch! Take part in a gaming company's office life, or play old-school games with your friends.
体验加班赶工！参与游戏公司的办公室生活，或者和朋友们一起玩老派游戏。
modules.theme_generalfantasy.label: Theme: General Fantasy
主题：常规奇幻
modules.theme_generalfantasy.description: Behold a land where men wield magic swords, and elves sing songs of valor. Experience epic battles, and legendary adventures.
看哪，在这片土地上，人们挥舞魔剑，精灵吟唱英勇之歌。体验史诗般的战斗和传奇冒险。
modules.theme_goldenagescifi.label: Theme: Golden Age Scifi
主题：黄金时代科幻
modules.theme_goldenagescifi.description: No computers or long distance communications, just spaceships, robots, lasers, and (mostly) men surviving on their wits against the galaxy.
没有电脑，也没有远程通信，只有飞船、机器人、激光，以及（大多是）男人凭借智慧在银河中求生。
modules.theme_hardsf.label: Theme: Hard SF
主题：硬科幻
modules.theme_hardsf.description: Simply put, sci-fi that tries to be realistic. A lot of semi-plausible tech here!
简单来说，就是力求真实的科幻。这里有大量半可信的科技！
modules.theme_history.label: Theme: History
主题：历史
modules.theme_history.description: A pen is stronger than a sword. Rewrite history however you desire.
笔比剑更有力。随心所欲地改写历史吧。
modules.theme_horror.label: Theme: Horror
主题：恐怖
modules.theme_horror.description: Experience nightmares like never before. Indulge in the deepest depths of the human mind, and beyond...
体验前所未有的噩梦。沉溺于人类心灵最深处，乃至更远的地方……
modules.theme_huntergatherer.label: Theme: Hunter Gatherer
主题：狩猎采集
modules.theme_huntergatherer.description: When man discovered fire, a new age dawned upon the world. Enter the paleolithic, and discover the secrets of survival in our primitive past.
人类发现火的那一刻，世界迎来了新纪元。进入旧石器时代，探寻我们原始过去中的生存秘诀。
modules.theme_litrpg.label: Theme: LitRPG
主题：LitRPG
modules.theme_litrpg.description: Stat blocks and status conditions, monsters and magic spells; Level up your roleplaying experience!
属性面板和状态效果，怪物与魔法咒语；让你的角色扮演体验升级吧！
modules.theme_magicacademy.label: Theme: Magic Academy
主题：魔法学院
modules.theme_magicacademy.description: Learn spells from wizards old and young. One must choose their path wisely—and never stop learning.
向老少巫师们学习咒语。必须明智地选择自己的道路——而且永远不要停止学习。
modules.theme_libraries.label: Theme: Magic Library
主题：魔法图书馆
modules.theme_libraries.description: They say a book is a gateway to another world. In this magical collection, the adage may be more literal than expected.
人们说，书是通往另一个世界的大门。在这个魔法藏书馆里，这句老话可能比想象中更名副其实。
modules.theme_lightnovels.label: Theme: Light Novels
主题：轻小说
modules.theme_lightnovels.description: Get your dose of otaku medicine, with a dash of isekai, fantasy, slice of life and some romance!
来一剂宅男良药，加点异世界、奇幻、日常和恋爱！
modules.theme_mars.label: Theme: Mars Colonization
主题：火星殖民
modules.theme_mars.description: Brave pioneers set foot on another world. What would it take to tame the red planet?
勇敢的先驱者踏上另一个世界。要怎样才能驯服这颗红色星球？
modules.theme_medieval.label: Theme: Medieval
主题：中世纪
modules.theme_medieval.description: A new age dawns as knights rise and empires fall. Take up sword and shield, or cloak and dagger                 in this archaic setting.
骑士崛起，帝国陨落，新的时代来临。在这个古老的背景下，拿起剑与盾，或是披风与匕首。
modules.theme_militaryscifi.label: Theme: Military SciFi
主题：军事科幻
modules.theme_militaryscifi.description: Though the weapons changed, war remained the same. From futuristic trenches to intergalactic starfighters,                 experience life at the front lines.
武器变了，战争却一如既往。从未来的战壕到星际战斗机，体验前线的生活。
modules.theme_music.label: Theme: Music
主题：音乐
modules.theme_music.description: The world of touring bands, drugs, and groupies! Can you resist temptation or stay focused on your art?
巡演乐队、毒品和追星族的世界！你能抵挡诱惑，专注于你的艺术吗？
modules.theme_mystery.label: Theme: Mystery
主题：推理
modules.theme_mystery.description: Whodunit? Conduct investigations into mysteries that abound. Poke your nose into places where it doesn't belong.
谁是凶手？调查层出不穷的谜团，把鼻子伸进不该伸的地方。
modules.theme_nature.label: Theme: Nature
主题：自然
modules.theme_nature.description: Survive the elements of rugged terrain, climb sheer mountains, and forge a path through the wilderness.
在崎岖的地形中抵御风雨，攀登陡峭的山峰，在荒野中开辟道路。
modules.theme_naval.label: Theme: Naval Age of Discovery
主题：大航海时代
modules.theme_naval.description: Sail the seven seas aboard mighty ships, while exploring exotic ports and uncharted waters.
乘坐巨舰航行七海，探索异国港口和未知的海域。
modules.theme_noir.label: Theme: Noir
主题：黑色小说
modules.theme_noir.description: Cynical detectives, hard-boiled dialogue, and black and white morality.
愤世嫉俗的侦探、冷硬的对白，以及非黑即白的道德。
modules.theme_philosophy.label: Theme: Philosophy
主题：哲学
modules.theme_philosophy.description: Let philosophical and political figures from old and new guide your stories.
让古今的哲学和政治人物引导你的故事。
modules.theme_pirates.label: Theme: Pirates
主题：海盗
modules.theme_pirates.description: There be loot to plunder on the high seas! 'Course, ye best be ready when the galleons come calling...
公海上有战利品等着抢！当然，盖伦大帆船找上门来时，你最好已经做好准备……
modules.theme_poeticfantasy.label: Theme: Poetic Fantasy
主题：诗意奇幻
modules.theme_poeticfantasy.description: Craft beautiful poetry and stories, set in a curious land of magic and wonder, with delicate prose. Fairy dust not included.
在一片充满魔法与奇迹的奇妙土地上，用细腻的文笔创作优美的诗歌和故事。仙尘需自备。
modules.theme_postapocalyptic.label: Theme: Post-Apocalyptic
主题：后启示录
modules.theme_postapocalyptic.descriptio: The world has ended, but the story continues. Scavenge for supplies and face fearsome mutated beasts.
世界已经终结，但故事仍在继续。搜寻物资，直面可怕的变异野兽。
modules.theme_rats.label: Theme: Rats
主题：老鼠
modules.theme_rats.description: Preying and stalking through the night, these little squeakers seek food and shelter wherever they find it. Eeek!
这些吱吱叫的小家伙在夜里四处觅食潜行，哪里有食物和藏身之处就往哪里钻。吱！
modules.theme_romanempire.label: Theme: Roman Empire
主题：罗马帝国
modules.theme_romanempire.description: When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
入乡随俗，在罗马就照罗马人的规矩来。
modules.theme_sciencefantasy.label: Theme: Science Fantasy
主题：科学奇幻
modules.theme_sciencefantasy.description: Each step within these storied lands whispers tales of civilizations long forgotten where great technological works were once regarded as witchcraft.
在这片充满传说的土地上，每一步都在低语着早已被遗忘的文明，那里伟大的科技成就曾被视为巫术。
modules.theme_spaceopera.label: Theme: Space Opera
主题：太空歌剧
modules.theme_spaceopera.description: Soar between asteroids, explode planets, find your alien love, or maybe even start an intergalactic war. Infinite universe, infinite possibilities.
在小行星之间翱翔，炸毁行星，找到你的外星恋人，甚至发动一场星际战争。无限的宇宙，无限的可能。
modules.theme_superheroes.label: Theme: Superheroes
主题：超级英雄
modules.theme_superheroes.description: When heroes clash with villains, only one can emerge victorious. Stand for justice, or join forces against it.
英雄与反派交锋，只有一方能取得胜利。是捍卫正义，还是联手与之对抗？
modules.theme_airships.label: Theme: Steampunk
主题：蒸汽朋克
modules.theme_airships.description: Soar above the clouds and into a world of adventure, clockwork engines and flying machines.
翱翔于云层之上，进入一个充满冒险、发条引擎和飞行器的世界。
modules.theme_travel.label: Theme: Travel
主题：旅行
modules.theme_travel.description: Travel around the world on years-long journeys to the darkest jungles, highest peaks, deepest seas, driest deserts, and see the myriad Wonders of the World!
环游世界，踏上长达数年的旅程，前往最幽暗的丛林、最高的山峰、最深的海洋、最干旱的沙漠，见识无数世界奇观！
modules.theme_urbanfantasy.label: Theme: Urban Fantasy
主题：都市奇幻
modules.theme_urbanfantasy.description: Interact with elves, fairies and other fantasy creatures in a modern urban environment where magic exists!
在魔法存在的现代都市中，与精灵、仙子和其他奇幻生物打交道！
modules.theme_valentines.label: Theme: Valentines
主题：情人节
modules.theme_valentines.description: This module is sure to make your heart flutter! Keep the sparks flying with this module trained on a collection of romantic literature!
这个模组一定会让你心跳加速！它以一系列浪漫文学作品训练而成，让火花不断迸发！
modules.theme_vikings.label: Theme: Vikings
主题：维京人
modules.theme_vikings.description: Raise your swords and shields, screaming on the way to Valhalla!
举起你的剑与盾，呐喊着奔向英灵殿！
modules.theme_weirdwest.label: Theme: Weird West
主题：怪诞西部
modules.theme_weirdwest.description: Take to the dusty trail and encounter magical natives, werewolf cowboys, and undead creatures of the wild west.
踏上尘土飞扬的小路，遭遇荒野西部的魔法原住民、狼人牛仔和不死生物。
modules.theme_westernromance.label: Theme: Western Romance
主题：西部浪漫
modules.theme_westernromance.description: Blaze the open trails with a big iron on your hip, and maybe a pretty pardner as well.
腰挎大号左轮，或许再带上一位漂亮的搭档，在开阔的小路上开辟道路。
modules.inspiration_crabsnailandmonkey.d: High school gets weird in this unique mixture of slice of life, romance, and supernatural mystery.
日常、恋爱与超自然悬疑的独特混合，让高中生活变得古怪起来。
modules.inspiration_mercantilewolfgirlro: 灵感：商人与狼娘的恋曲
A merchant and a wolf girl goddess travelling the lands.
一位商人和一位狼少女女神结伴游历四方。
modules.inspiration_nervegear.label: Inspiration: Nervegear
灵感：NerveGear
modules.inspiration_nervegear.descriptio: It's all fun and games, until the users of a VR MMORPG find they can't log out.
一切本来只是游戏，直到一款 VR MMORPG 的玩家发现自己无法登出。
modules.theme_romanceofthreekingdoms.lab: Inspiration: Romance of the Three Kingdoms
modules.theme_romanceofthreekingdoms.des: China's greatest warlords vie for supremacy. Experience the art of war on a grand scale, in one of the most renowned tales ever told.
中国最伟大的军阀们争夺霸权。在史上最负盛名的故事之一中，体验宏大规模的兵法。
modules.inspiration_thronewars.label: Inspiration: Throne Wars
灵感：王座战争
modules.inspiration_thronewars.descripti: As the kingdom faces invasion from within and without, one must make difficult choices; to fight with honor, or or rule by fear?
王国内忧外患之际，必须做出艰难的抉择：是以荣誉而战，还是以恐惧统治？
modules.inspiration_witchatlevelcap.desc: Having gone to another world and maxed out her level cap, a witch lives a laid back life.
去到另一个世界、等级已经练到满级的魔女，过着悠闲的生活。
